C1027.title: Former Employee Account Used to Breach Corporate Internal Network
C1027.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) issued an alert confirming a cyberattack where unidentified threat actors used a former employee's account to obtain network administrator credentials. They then authenticated via an internal VPN access point and navigated the victim organization's on-premises environment. This incident highlights the severe security risk created when departed-employee accounts and privileged credentials are not promptly removed or protected with MFA.
